title: Fundrasing platform
tagline: Polyseed - fundraising project for social causes using web3 payment systems
description: Polyseed, is a a fundraising platform for social causes. The users of this platform can use web3 payment systems enabled by the Sequence web wallet SDK. Examples of some social causes could be: a poor child needing money for his education, a coder with a recurrent activity on github that accepts tips from other fellow coders, reforestation projects that need additional funds, restoring entertainment places such as theaters from your local area. Youtube full presentation can be found at: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TF1CshpSxe0
how_its_made: This project is at the Proof of Concept stage. Is written in REACT with typescript, uses localStorage for storing metadata related to the traditional web app.  For the authentication and the payment part uses the sequence SDK. The project is made from scratch for this hackaton.  Using the Sequence modal web wallet allowed me to integrate blockchain systems easily in my application.
